api ca raksasa rasataLe acCaditajagata varaharupina Bagavata acCadakajaladudDrtya prakasitatvaca kaTanisacCadyatvan? “taneva BantananuBa sarvan” (sve.u. 6.14, nu.u. 2.2.1) iti ca tatpaksa atopi nesacCadyatvan kin ca “yadadityagatan tejo jagadBasayateKilan yacandranasi yacagnO tatejo vidDi nanakan” (Ba.gi. 15.12) iti gitayan jagadisena krsnenEvoktatvat kaTanisacCadyan jagat ? ato “yatkincid” etat pratyuta “tadavyaktanaha hi” (bra. su. 3.2.23), “yatadadresyanagrahyan” (nu.u. 1.1.6), “adrsyatvadigunako Darnokta " ( bra. su. 1.2.21), "nayayavanikacCunanahine brahnane nana” ityadisrutisnrtiBya, svanate brahnEva acCadyan brahnano jagadaropaDisWanatvangikaraca svaprakriyaya brahnEva acCadyan evan ca isacCadyatvena tyage brahnana evan tyagaprasanga, na tu karnana atopi svajnanavijrnBitanevedan vyaKyanan api ca jagadisacCadyan cet karna kuta tyajyan? karnanopi jagadantapatitvad iti cet tarhi noksasaDanananovrtirupa aparoksajnanasyapi tata evopeksyatvan syat ? kin ca indravayvadirupataya nahajnaniBi panqavEreva nahata prayatnena rajasuyasvaneDadikarnanan krtatvatkaTan jnanina karna tyajyan ? kin ca nahajnaninan parTan prati “karnanyevaDikaraste na Palesu kadacana" (Ba.gi. 2.47) iti nivrtarupakarnanyeva jnanina evaDikarasyoktatvat anenEva ‘kvacit karnanan tyajyatvokti kanyakarnananeva iti sucitan “ niyatasya tu sanyasa karnano nopapadyate nohat tasya parityaga tanasa parikirtita” (Ba.gi. 18. 7) iti sanDyavandanadikarnananatyajyatvasyEva Bagavata kaTanaca “palayeTa” ityatra palanavisayataya karna ca na parena vaktun sakyan isacCadyasakalajagatanupeksane sati atnE rvarita eva ca svatnananeva tvan palayeTa ityuktan syat?
